questions.q: Why do operations, marketing and CX teams fall out of sync at multi-location brands?
questions.a: Feedback usually lives in separate dashboards, so each team sees only part of the picture. Ops may hear about a service issue weeks later, while marketing launches campaigns without input from the frontline. Without a clear owner for follow-up, trends get missed and recovery slows down.

questions.q: How does AI help teams work from the same data?
questions.a: An AI customer experience platform brings reviews, surveys, case logs and operational signals into one place. It summarizes what's happening in plain language and routes each issue to the right person. Ops gets location alerts, CX tracks recovery, marketing sees what resonates and leadership sees which regions need help.

questions.q: What should I look for in an AI platform for cross-team alignment?
questions.a: You don't need to replace your whole tech stack. Look for one platform that connects to your review, survey and support tools, gives AI summaries and recommendations, routes feedback by function, urgency or location, and tracks outcomes until each issue is closed. Momos was built for this, from location-level guest recovery to feeding review insights back into marketing.

questions.q: What results can better alignment bring?
questions.a: When every team works from the same source of truth, responses get faster and campaigns can reflect what guests actually say. Store managers hear about reputation dips sooner, and leadership can act on real-time customer data. Over time, that consistency shows up in a better guest experience across locations.
